loadError.title: Invoices did not load
loadError.text: Could not get the data. Please try again.

unavailable.title: The service is not responding
unavailable.text: ERP or document flow is temporarily unavailable. Nothing is lost — try again shortly.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.text: The “Invoices & payments” section is not available to your role.

erpForbidden.title: Customer invoices are not shown to you
erpForbidden.text: Money on invoices is visible to accounting and the director. Memos to pay on the neighbouring tab are available.

notGranted.title: No access to document flow
notGranted.text: Your account has not been added to document flow yet. Contact the administrator.

notFound.title: Invoice not found
notFound.text: There is no such invoice or it is not visible to your role.

memoNotFound.title: Memo not found
memoNotFound.text: There is no such memo, it is not a memo, or it is not visible to your role.

list.subtitle: Customer invoices, payment orders to confirm and memos to pay.

search.label: Search by invoice number or customer

list.caption: Invoices
list.select: Show invoice {{number}} in the side panel

to_issue.title: No invoices to issue
to_issue.text: The prepayment invoice appears here once the project contract is signed.

awaiting.title: No invoices awaiting payment
awaiting.text: Issued invoices wait for payment here. See customer payment orders on the “Payment orders to confirm” tab.

proofs.title: No payment orders to confirm
proofs.text: A payment order appears here when you attach it to an invoice. The “I have paid” button in the customer cabinet and the bot will send them automatically once it is built.

overdue.title: No overdue invoices
overdue.text: An invoice lands here when its due date has passed and the money has not arrived.

all.title: No invoices yet
all.text: Invoices appear after project contracts are signed.

search.title: Nothing found
search.text: Check the invoice number or the customer name.

readOnly.title: View only
readOnly.text: Payments are confirmed by the accountant. You can see payment orders and the invoice history.

paid.title: Invoice paid
paid.text: The money is received and recorded. Payment history is below.

draft.title: Invoice not issued yet
draft.text: A payment can only be confirmed for an issued invoice.

cancelled.title: Invoice cancelled
cancelled.text: A cancelled invoice does not accept payment.

proofs.title: Customer payment orders
proofs.none: No payment order yet. Ask the customer to send it or attach the file if it came by email.

state.EXTRA: Extra: the invoice is already paid

file.label: Payment order file
file.hint: PDF, image or Office document, up to 25 MB

reasons.not_open: the invoice no longer awaits payment, the card is refreshed
reasons.forbidden: the action is not allowed for your role
reasons.too_large: the file is larger than 25 MB
reasons.unsupported: PDF, images and Office documents are allowed
reasons.unavailable: the service is not responding, the file stayed in the form
reasons.unknown: something went wrong, the file stayed in the form

confirm.name: Payment confirmation

amount.label: Amount per bank statement
amount.hint: Invoice balance: {{balance}}. Less than the balance means a partial payment.

date.label: Date received
date.hint: Per bank statement, not later than today

reference.label: Bank operation number
reference.hint: Optional. Repeating the same number does not create a second payment.

confirm.partialHint: Enter the amount received — it is less than the balance.
confirm.replayed: This payment was already confirmed — nothing was recorded again.

full.step2: Project {{project}} moves to “Payment done” once all its invoices are paid.
full.step3: The customer gets a payment message in Telegram — if the bot is on and the contact has connected it.

partial.step2: The balance stays on “Awaiting payment” — confirm it when the money arrives.
partial.step3: The customer message about payment goes out once the invoice is fully paid.

confirm.invalidAmount: Enter an amount above zero, for example 1500000.00.
confirm.invalidDate: Enter a received date not later than today.

reasons.exceeds_balance: the amount is above the invoice balance ({{balance}}), nothing was recorded
reasons.already_paid: the invoice is already paid in full, the card is refreshed
reasons.not_issued: the invoice is not issued yet
reasons.not_open: the invoice no longer awaits payment, the card is refreshed
reasons.reference_conflict: a payment with this operation number is already recorded with another amount or date
reasons.forbidden: the action is not allowed for your role
reasons.unavailable: the service is not responding, your input stayed in the form
reasons.validation: check the amount and the date
reasons.not_found: the payment order or invoice was not found, the card is refreshed
reasons.unknown: something went wrong, your input stayed in the form

request.title: Message to the customer
request.label: Message text
request.template: Hello! Please send the payment order for invoice {{number}} for {{amount}}. Due date: {{due}}. Thank you!
request.templateNoDue: Hello! Please send the payment order for invoice {{number}} for {{amount}}. Thank you!
request.note: There is no automatic sending to the customer’s bot or email yet: copy the text, send it in “Chats”, then mark the request.
request.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text by hand.
request.done: Payment order request noted in the invoice log

code.payment_doc_requested: Payment order requested from the customer

payments.title: Payments
payments.none: No payments on this invoice yet.
payments.caption: Payments on the invoice

memo.caption: Memos to pay
memo.select: Show memo {{number}} in the side panel

to_pay.title: No memos to pay
to_pay.text: Memos with an amount appear here after the director approves them, together with the supplier invoice.

paid.title: No paid memos yet
paid.text: Paid memos stay here with the date, amount and payment order.

panel.noFiles: No supplier invoice attached. Return the memo to the author so they attach the invoice.
panel.paidText: Paid {{date}}: {{amount}}. The payment order and date are in the memo log.

readOnly.title: View only
readOnly.text: The accountant whose step it is pays the memo. You can see the supplier invoice and the log.

notYourStep.title: Not your step
notYourStep.text: Another accountant pays this memo, and a colleague pays your own memo.

form.name: Memo payment

receipt.label: Payment order
receipt.hint: PDF, image or Office document, up to 25 MB. Optional

form.invalidAmount: Enter an amount above zero, for example 1500000.00.
form.invalidDate: Enter a payment date not later than today.

consequence.step2: The date, amount and payment order are written to the memo log.
consequence.step3: The memo goes to the document archive.

return.label: Reason for return
return.hint: Required: the author sees it and fixes the memo.

reasons.amount_exceeds_approved: the amount is above what the director approved
reasons.amount_currency_mismatch: the payment currency differs from the memo currency
reasons.amount_must_be_positive: the amount must be above zero
reasons.paid_on_in_future: the payment date is in the future
reasons.already_paid: the memo is already paid with other data, the card is refreshed
reasons.invalid_state: the memo is not with the accountant, the card is refreshed
reasons.route_closed: the memo is already decided, the card is refreshed
reasons.not_your_step: it is not your step now
reasons.file: the payment order is unavailable, upload it again
reasons.forbidden: the action is not allowed for your role
reasons.unavailable: the document service is not responding, your input stayed in the form
reasons.validation: check the amount and the date
reasons.unknown: something went wrong, your input stayed in the form
